test_title: PYST 20 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, in each option a pair of figures is given. In each pair the figure towards the left of (:) is related by some logic/rule/relation with the figure on the right of (:). Select the odd figure pair from the given alternatives.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In Options 1, 3, and 4, the figure on the right is a vertically inverted (flipped) version of the figure on the left.

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16dc991dbf73a0f499fad1f1a2dc6bc9ffb51bad2dc56eef24e742529de43021.png] 

Left Arrow → Right Arrow

Middle Arrow → Middle Arrow (flipped)

Right Arrow → Right Arrow (flipped)
⇒ Follows the vertical flip pattern correctly.

**Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4f8d542a1bce3ddfd5e65be7e256f8997ad0de3d83d4937131e4a057e719490.png] 

Left: Circle at bottom → Arrow at bottom (symbol changes, no flip)

Middle: Black circle at bottom → Black circle at bottom (no flip)

Right: Arrow at top → Circle at top (symbol changes, no flip)
⇒ Does **not** follow the vertical flip pattern. Symbols change and are static.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dfb2c40b7ab8f186eecf8980ca3f02e5f772d5cd9eea7a8633c04796736ecd4.png] 

Left: Arrow up → Circle at bottom (flipped correctly)

Middle: Square at bottom → Square at top (flipped correctly)

Right: Circle at top → Arrow pointing down (flipped correctly)
⇒ Follows the vertical flip pattern.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df6d51167d1859bb7e863874fc789d4a43c70bc55a4559b4eb36841386c0f8e2.png] 

Left: Single Arrow Up → Black Circle Top (flipped correctly)

Middle: Double Arrow Down → Double Arrow Up (flipped correctly)

Right: Black Circle Bottom → Single Arrow Down (flipped correctly)
⇒ Follows the vertical flip pattern

In Option 2, the symbols on the lines change their shape and do not follow the vertical inversion rule.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
